definitions.gloss: equating; identifying with; treating as the same
definitions.explanation: Regarding two distinct things as identical or equivalent. Often used when pointing out that such an equation is problematic or incorrect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同一視|どういつし}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
⟦{愛国心|あいこくしん}→愛国心：18303_aikokushin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{国粋主義|こくすいしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同一視|どういつし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧だ。
examples.english: It's wrong to equate patriotism with ultranationalism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同一視|どういつし}しやすい。
examples.english: Children tend to identify themselves with the protagonist.

notes: Almost always used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Common patterns: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同一視|どういつし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to equate A with B), A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同一視|どういつし}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be identified with A). Often appears in argumentative or analytical writing when cautioning against treating different things as the same. Composed of ⟦{同一|どういつ}→同一：01759_douitsu⟧ (identical, same) + {視|し} (viewing). Related: {同列|どうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧ (to treat as equal), ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to lump together — more colloquial).
